answer: Sybil resistance here comes from peer grading that is financially coupled to accuracy, meaning a flood of fake accounts drags down the whole jury's expected reward. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Consider a ridge at the center, a zenith resting nearby, and a nectar beyond the hills: three anchors, none forged, all earned over time.
